full_name_ar: كلثوم بن الأقمر الوادعي أخو علي
bio: Ibn Sa'd's al-Tabaqat al-Kubra identifies him as al-Wadi'i of Hamdan. Al-'Ijli's al-Thiqat calls him a trustworthy (thiqa) Kufan and brother of 'Ali ibn al-Aqmar. Al-Bukhari and Ibn Abi Hatim record that he narrated from Zirr ibn Hubaysh and that al-Aswad ibn Qays narrated from him.

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat describes him as the father of Abu Ma'shar, counted among the people of Kufa, narrating from 'Umar. His son Ziyad ibn Kulayb Abu Ma'shar narrated from him.

full_name_ar: كرز بن وبرة العابد كوفي سمع أنس ب
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil records that he narrated from Nu'aym ibn Abi Hind and that al-Thawri, Ibn Shubruma, 'Ubaydullah al-Wassafi, Fudayl ibn Ghazwan and Warqa' ibn 'Umar narrated from him. Ibn al-Athir's Usd al-Ghaba (citing 'Abdan) calls him al-Harithi and states he was not a companion, transmitting a mursal report from the Prophet.
research_evidence: كرز بن وبرة روى عن نعيم بن أبي هند روى عنه الثوري وابن شبرمة وعبيد الله الوصافى وفضيل بن غزوان وورقاء بن عمر

full_name_ar: محمد بن عمرو بن أبي ضرار الخزاعي
